findings.title: Isolated-worktree/reproducibility violation
findings.detail: tools/build.py:12-13 and tools/gate.py:67,136 resolve JavaScript dependencies from an absolute different-worktree path. This directly conflicts with the original prohibition on accessing other worktrees and makes the claimed isolated reproducer environment-dependent. It is the acceptance blocker; it is not a machine-semantic failure.

findings.title: Parent basis metadata is inconsistent
findings.detail: parent-input.json:2 and pins.json:2 identify basis 5b55d0ce6 instead of the required parent-3ed302a92, and verify_source.py enforces the mismatch. The four source hashes and diff bases do point to parent-3ed302a92, so the mechanical delta itself remains credible.

findings.title: Evidence-completeness claim cannot be reproduced from the blind packet
findings.detail: The report claims a manifest and complete 62-file hashed archive, but only the gate summary and checksum listing are present; manifest.json is not itself in SHA256SUMS. Machine results remain authoritative, but independent receipt/build audit is incomplete.

findings.title: Boundary and canonical regression assertions are narrower than the evidence

Canonical receipt verification covers the six ordinary successful worlds, not reordered30; the separate checkpoint inspection does validate reordered30 and n+83.

findings.detail: tools/gate.py:53-66 proves all raw classes initialized but does not explicitly assert decoded classCount==raw+83. Strict source preservation and canonical receipts reduce the risk, but a direct assertion would improve the gate.

findings.title: Blind evidence archive is incomplete

preference.reason: B preserves the same exact product delta and passing semantics while using current-worktree dependencies, consistent parent provenance, stricter exact boundary assertions, and canonical verification of reordered30. A's direct cross-worktree dependency violates an explicit task constraint.

remaining_uncertainty: The blind packet intentionally or accidentally omits almost every file named by both checksum manifests. This prevents independent replay of full receipt and build archives, but does not override the supplied authoritative machine passes.
